summary.text:
Protecting Options for Seniors Act of 2025
This bill increases payments for Medicare Advantage plans in areas in which the average hospital wage index increased by more than 20% compared to the previous year. Payment increases are based on the percentage by which the average hospital wage index increased compared to the previous year and weighted by the proportion of attributable payments in the area.

title: Protecting Options for Seniors Act of 2025
